title: Song - Immortal, Invisible
subtitle: Arrangement: the tune with left-hand waltz accompaniment (bass, then chord, chord)
trains: Immortal, Invisible in G major and 3/4, with a one-beat pickup, over a waltz left hand (the bass on beat 1, the chord on beats 2 and 3), one chord a bar (C, D, G, Em).

provenance.author: claude-opus-5.5
provenance.basedOn: mutopia-1291-st-denio: St. Denio (hymntune: Immortal, Invisible), SATB, sounding G major; the tune is in the Soprano (https://www.mutopiaproject.org/cgibin/piece-info.cgi?id=1291)
provenance.note: Melody from www.cyberhymnal.org (https://www.mutopiaproject.org/cgibin/piece-info.cgi?id=1291), public domain; left-hand chords our own (CC0)

departures: The left-hand waltz accompaniment (bass, then chord, chord) is our own (CC0).
